July 25, 2026

Consistent conditions make for a solid day on Wausau-area rivers and streams

The Wisconsin River is running at 836 cfs with steady barometric pressure keeping conditions consistent. Expect daylight from 5:36 a.m. to 8:33 p.m. Today looks like the best fishing day this week, with dry skies on area rivers and lakes.
